kaverin_1.m: From the looks of you, you don't seem to be from around here. That makes two of us then. He he.
r: I'm from the village of Crossglen, far to the west of here.

kaverin_2.m: Crossglen! I know that place, it's not far from Fallhaven, right?

kaverin_3.m: I have an old ... shall we say ... friend ... from Fallhaven. Goes by the name of Unzel.

kaverin_4.m: You wouldn't by any chance have met him, would you?
r: Yes, I've met that fool. He was an easy kill.
Yes, I have met him. I still have some of his blood on my boots.
Yes, I even helped him defeat a scoundrel named Vacor.

kaverin_5.m: I guess he keeps to himself. I sure hope he is OK. If you ever run into him, please say hi to him for me.
r: I'm trying to find my brother Andor, have you seen him?

kaverin_5b.m: Andor? No, I'm sorry. I've never heard of him.

kaverin_6.m: You?! But ... but ... this is terrible! I bet you are one of the goons of that Vacor fellow.

kaverin_7.m: Excellent, that is good news indeed! May you walk with the Shadow, my friend!

kaverin_8.m: Would you be willing to deliver a message to him?

kaverin_8r.m: My friend from Fallhaven returns. It's comforting to hear that Unzel is still alive.

kaverin_9.m: You'd be well compensated for your efforts.
r: Anything for the sake of the Shadow.
No, I am done helping you people.

kaverin_accept1.m: Good, that's exactly what I wanted to hear.

kaverin_accept2.m: Make sure this doesn't fall into the hands of Feygard, or her loyalists.

r: You can count on me, Kaverin.

kaverin_accept4.m: Good. Now go deliver that message to Unzel.

kaverin_decline1.m: That is unfortunate, you seemed like such a bright boy too.

kaverin_decline2.m: The friend from Fallhaven returns. Please leave me be, I have things to do.

kaverin_done1.m: Thank you, my friend. May you walk in the glow of the Shadow.

kaverin_done2.m: Take this map as compensation for a job well done.

kaverin_done3.m: We've discovered one of Vacor's hideouts, far to the south.

kaverin_done4.m: Since you helped us stop him, it's fitting that you have this.

kaverin_done5.m: According to the map, the hideout should be just to the northwest of the former prison of Flagstone. Feel free to take whatever is left in there.

kaverin_done6.m: Walk with the Shadow, my friend.

kaverin_done_ret.m: Hello again. It's comforting to know that Unzel is still alive, and that you delivered my message to him.

kaverin_fight_1.m: Oh yes, I can feel it. You work for Vacor! He must be stopped!

kaverin_return1.m: It's good to see you again. Have you delivered my message to Unzel?

kaverin_return2.m: Please don't take too long. Walk with the Shadow, my friend.

vacor.10:
A mage called Vacor in southwest Fallhaven has been trying to cast a rift spell.
There was something not right about him, he seemed very obsessed with his spell. Something about him gaining a power from it.
vacor.20: Vacor wants me to bring him the four pieces of the rift spell that he claims was stolen from him. The four bandits should be somewhere south of Fallhaven.
vacor.30: I have brought the four pieces of the rift spell to Vacor.
vacor.40: Vacor tells me about his former apprentice Unzel, who had started to question Vacor. Vacor now wants me to kill Unzel. I should be able to find him to the southwest outside of Fallhaven. I should bring his signet ring to Vacor once I have killed him.
vacor.50: Unzel gives me a choice to side with either Vacor or him.
vacor.51: I have chosen to side with Unzel. I should go to southwest Fallhaven to talk to Vacor about Unzel and the Shadow.
vacor.53: I started a fight with Unzel. I should bring his ring to Vacor once he is dead.
vacor.54: I started a fight with Vacor. I should bring his ring to Unzel once he is dead.
vacor.60: I have killed Unzel and told Vacor about the deed.
vacor.61: I have killed Vacor and told Unzel about the deed.

kaverin.10: I met Kaverin in Remgard, that apparently is an old acquaintance of Unzel, who lives outside of Fallhaven.
kaverin.20: Kaverin wants me to deliver a message to Unzel.
kaverin.21: I have declined to help Kaverin.
kaverin.22: I have agreed to deliver the message.
kaverin.25: Kaverin has given me the message that he wants me to deliver to Unzel.
kaverin.30: I have delivered the message to Unzel. I should return to Kaverin in Remgard.
kaverin.40: Kaverin thanked me for delivering the message to Unzel.
kaverin.45: In return, Kaverin gave me an old map that he had acquired. Apparently, it leads to Vacor's old hideout.
kaverin.60: Kaverin was furious over the fact that I killed Unzel, and that I helped Vacor. He started attacking me. I should return to Vacor once Kaverin is dead.
kaverin.70: Kaverin was carrying a sealed message. Vacor immediately recognized the seal, and seemed very interested in it.
kaverin.75: I have given Vacor the message that Kaverin was carrying. In return, Vacor gave me an old map, leading to his old hideout.
kaverin.90: I should try to find Vacor's old hideout, on the road to the west of the former prison of Flagstone, southwest of Fallhaven.
kaverin.100: I have found Vacor's old hideout.
